;*******************************************************************************************************************************
;** Coverage: display rounding under DRM in ALL 3 where the X line width cuts the digits. ROUND keeps what the line shows;    **
;** RXT checks the stored text. DRM 0 to 6; exponents -12, -8, -6 to -1 and 22, where the width cuts 16 to 19 digits, and     **
;** 5, where the 20 digit cap cuts. Points rounding at the cut: digits of pi, a tie, the tie plus and minus one in the 34th   **
;** digit, a tie on the other parity; positive and negative. The cut per exponent was measured on t47 with the digits of pi;  **
;** see probe/gen_drm_ext_cov.py. Expected: Python decimal from that rule.                                                    **
;*******************************************************************************************************************************

Out: EC=0
